title: Archero Bow Legend
description: Run, stop, and loose rapid-fire arrow volleys across roguelike dungeon rooms—stack ricochet, multishot, and fire arrows to conquer every boss.
controls: Drag to dodge projectiles and release to stand still and auto-fire arrows at the nearest enemy.

zh-CN.title: 弓箭手传说
zh-CN.description: 现象级动作肉鸽鼻祖弓箭手传说：移动走位躲弹幕、停步自动连射箭雨，叠加弹射多重箭一路通关打爆 Boss！
zh-CN.controls: 拖动摇杆走位躲避怪物攻击，松手停步即可自动向最近敌人射出箭雨，升级叠加神技。
